public_page_goal: Interactive Markdown lecture notes for MAE598/494 Design Optimization: gradient descent fundamentals, line search, and convergence analysis.
slide_outline: Gradient descent update and steepest descent interpretation.
Termination criterion and first/second-order optimality conditions.
Line search: exact and Armijo backtracking.
Convergence assumptions: L-smoothness, convexity, strong convexity, Hessian Lipschitz continuity.
Convergence rates for nonconvex smooth, convex smooth, and strongly convex smooth objectives.
Ill-conditioning slows gradient descent: the role of the condition number.
Frequency principle: neural networks trained with GD resolve low-frequency components first.
